cv_notice.acknowledgement: I agree to MomentumQuest reading this CV and sending it to the employer with my application. I can remove it at any time.
cv_notice.body:
Your CV is read so that MomentumQuest can suggest the skills, education and experience to include in your application. You can edit or remove anything that was read from it before you submit.

The file itself is kept and sent to the employer with your application, because reading a CV loses things a person would notice.

Only the employer you applied to can open it, and only for that application. It is deleted six months after you apply, and you can remove it yourself at any time without withdrawing your application.
cv_notice.heading: How we use your CV

blocks.text: MomentumQuest is a career and learning support platform that helps students manage skills, identify skill gaps, obtain learning and job recommendations, explore opportunities, submit applications and track their progress.

This version records the change from administrator-endorsed certificate skills to skills declared directly by the student. It also retains the transcript and CV processing terms introduced by earlier versions.
Please read this notice before creating an account or uploading a document.
A. Account and student information

items: account login and authentication information; and
other information you voluntarily provide in your student profile.

blocks.text: B. Academic and skills information

items: completed courses and training programmes; and
other supporting academic or professional information you submit.

blocks.text: C. Career and learning information

items: career interests and interested job titles;

blocks.text: D. Technical information

items: the IP address from which a consent or a sensitive document action was performed, recorded in the privacy audit log so that access to identity-bearing documents can be accounted for.

blocks.text: Uploading a certificate or examination result is optional. If you choose to upload one, MomentumQuest processes it only as described in this notice.
Certificate skills are declarations you make yourself. They are added to your profile immediately and may affect skill gaps, learning recommendations and job recommendation matching.
You may withdraw document-processing consent later. This stops new document uploads but does not delete your account.

Certificate files are stored privately outside any publicly reachable media location and can be opened only by the student who uploaded them. Transcripts are deleted immediately after their subjects and grades have been read.
A certificate or transcript may contain your name, NRIC/MyKad or passport number, student or candidate number, institution, grades and other information appearing on the original document.

MomentumQuest never extracts or stores an NRIC/MyKad or passport number from these documents. Such a number is not used for matching or recommendations, copied into a filename or URL, written to ordinary logs, or disclosed to companies or other students.
From a transcript, MomentumQuest keeps the subject codes, grades and skills recognised from them. The transcript file itself is deleted as soon as reading finishes.

From a certificate, MomentumQuest keeps the skills and levels you select. They are self-declared and used immediately. No administrator reads the certificate and MomentumQuest does not confirm it with the issuer.
When you add a certificate, you choose the skills and levels that you believe it represents. Those declarations are added to your existing skill set immediately.

MomentumQuest does not verify the certificate, the issuing organisation, your completion of the course, or the skill level you selected. These skills must therefore be understood as self-declared, not endorsed or independently verified.
You can remove a self-declared certificate. MomentumQuest then recalculates the affected skills from any other live certificate or transcript records you still have.
When you apply for a job you may upload a CV so that MomentumQuest can prepare your application for you.
The CV is read once, in order to suggest the skills, education and experience to include. Reading it requires your consent, which is requested at the moment you upload it.

The CV file is kept and sent to the employer with your application. Reading a CV loses things a person would notice -- how you describe your own work, and what you chose to put first -- so the employer sees the document you wrote rather than only what was read out of it.

Only the employer you applied to can open it, and only for that application. It is not shown to other employers, not published, and not used for anything but the application you attached it to. An administrator can open it only to investigate a problem, and every time one does is recorded.
It is deleted six months after you apply. You can also remove it yourself at any time from your applications page, which does not withdraw the application.
Applications submitted before this version keep no CV. The files were deleted under the previous notice, which promised they would be, and none was retained.
Information taken from a CV and skills added from a certificate are treated as information you have declared, not as independently verified evidence.
Creating a MomentumQuest account does not give any company access to your personal information or your documents.

When you submit an application, the information in that application is shared with the employer concerned for recruitment purposes. That is the information you confirmed at the time of submitting: the skills, education and experience you declared, together with your answers on the application form and any contact details you provided.
The employer sees the application as you submitted it. Changes you make to your profile afterwards do not alter an application already sent.
Employers do not receive your certificates, transcripts, examination results or any identification number. New certificate skills are self-declared and are not presented as administrator-verified.
Students may access their own account and certificate files, and may not access another student's.
Certificate files are not available to administrators or companies. A transcript file is deleted immediately after processing, so no person can open it afterwards.
Companies may access applications submitted to their own job listings. They cannot access uploaded certificates, transcripts, NRIC/MyKad or passport numbers.

Certificate files are stored outside the public media directory under unpredictable filenames. They are reachable only through an authenticated endpoint that checks on every request that the requester is the owning student.
Uploaded files are validated by their actual content, not their filename, and only PDF, JPEG and PNG documents are accepted.

Identification information contained in an uploaded document is not copied into other databases, included in filenames, displayed in public profiles, included in analytics, written to ordinary application logs, sent to employers, or disclosed to other students.
CV files are deleted immediately after they are read. They are never retained.
Transcripts are deleted immediately after they are read, in the same way as CV files. Only the subjects, grades and skills read from them are kept.

Certificates are retained while your account is active and are deleted when the record or the account is deleted. There is no grace period: deleting a certificate removes the stored file as well as the database row.

Consent records are retained as historical evidence of what was agreed to and when. Withdrawing a consent records the withdrawal against the existing record; it does not erase it, because a record that could be erased would not be evidence.
Applications and the information submitted with them are retained for the employer's recruitment purposes.
You may withdraw a consent by contacting the MomentumQuest administrator.

Withdrawing document-processing consent disables new certificate and transcript uploads. Self-declared certificates can be removed separately; skills supported only by a removed or withdrawn record are recalculated.
Withdrawing consent does not delete your account, and does not by itself withdraw applications you have already submitted to employers.
A withdrawn consent cannot authorise any further processing. Past processing that took place while the consent was live remains lawful and its record is kept.
You may contact the MomentumQuest administrator to:

items: request access to your personal information;
ask how your information is being processed;
request deletion of information where applicable;
ask questions about this Privacy Notice.

blocks.text: MomentumQuest may update this Privacy Notice when the system or the handling of personal information changes.

Each version carries a version number and effective date, and your acknowledgement is recorded against the version you accepted. Earlier versions are preserved and earlier acknowledgements are never rewritten to refer to a newer version.
Where a change materially affects how your personal information is processed, you will be asked to acknowledge the new version the next time you use an affected function.

notice.summary:
MomentumQuest processes your personal and academic information to provide skill profiles, learning recommendations and job-matching functions.

Skills you add from a certificate are self-declared. They are added to your profile and used for recommendations immediately; MomentumQuest does not ask an administrator or the issuer to verify them. Certificate files are stored privately and can be opened only by you.

When you apply for a job, a CV you upload is read to prepare your application, kept for that application, and shared only with that employer.

transcript_notice.acknowledgement: I agree to MomentumQuest reading this document to recognise my skills. I understand the file is deleted immediately afterwards.
transcript_notice.body:
Your transcript is read once, and the file itself is not kept. It is deleted as soon as your subject codes and grades have been read from it, and no copy is stored.

What is kept is the information read from it: your subject codes, your grades, and the skills recognised from them. MomentumQuest never extracts or stores any identification number shown on the document.

Skills are added to your profile immediately. No administrator reads your transcript, and no administrator can: by the time the upload finishes, the document no longer exists.
